// Fixture for scripts/test-scripts.sh (wallclock-check): stored as .txt so the tree's
// tools never compile it. Every case below is a finding, and the line numbers are
// asserted by the script, so add new cases at the end.
import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

it("follows real time", async () => {
  vi.useFakeTimers({ shouldAdvanceTime: true });
  await screen.findByText("x", {}, { timeout: 500 });
  await waitFor(() => expect(1).toBe(1), { timeout: 1_000 });
});

it("sets its own deadline", async () => {
  await screen.findByText("y");
}, 5000);

it("uses the one second default", async () => {
  await vi.waitFor(() => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });
  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(2).toBe(2));
});

it("has a marker with no reason", async () => {
  // wall-clock:
  vi.useFakeTimers({ shouldAdvanceTime: true });
});
